Dębniki (dzielnica 8) — Kraków, Poland

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

The City of Kraków's own official resident-safety survey (end of 2022, published January 2023) rated Dębniki the single best district in the city: 88.0% of residents called their district safe, and Dębniki tied for the lowest share of residents able to name a specific "dangerous spot" in their district (just 1%). The 2020 Otodom survey independently rated the broader Dębniki/Łagiewniki/Borek Fałęcki/Swoszowice evening-safety group 3.99/5, also solidly positive. Sources checked: City of Kraków official resident-safety survey, krakow.pl (published January 2023); Otodom District Ranking 2020.

Wandroz currently rates Dębniki (dzielnica 8) in Kraków, Poland as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz at night.
